content.title: APUF-SNG: A Low-Cost Arbiter-PUF Stochastic Number Generator with Tunable Output Probability
content.abstract: Stochastic computing (SC) encodes numerical values as probabilistic bit-streams and enables arithmetic operations using simple logic gates, offering a promising paradigm for low- cost, fault-tolerant, and highly parallel computation. However, the accuracy and efficiency of SC systems depend on the quality of the stochastic number generator (SNG). Conventional SNGs rely on pseudo-random or quasi-random generators, whose deterministic nature introduces periodicity, correlation, and bias, limiting achievable accuracy and robustness.
